Calculate contribution per unit, break-even units, break-even revenue and the units needed for £90,000 operating profit. Explain whether that profit target is achievable within capacity.

- Break-even units = £180,000.00 ÷ £30.00 = 6000.00 units

- Units for £90,000.00 profit = (£180,000.00 + £90,000.00) ÷ £30.00 = 9000.00 units
- Maximum operating profit at capacity = 8000 × 30 − 180000 = £60,000.00.
